ip_limit_per_hour.description: Public submissions per hour from one network block; omitted: the server default.

key.description: Lower-case letters and digits in groups joined by `-`, at most 50 characters; unique.

Addresses mailed for each new submission (the mails carry the answers), up to 20.
Setting them also needs the permission `forms.read`.

items.description: The item tree (see the tool description for the shape of an item).

key.description: 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, `-` or `_`, e.g. `main` or `footer`.

locale.description: The menu's language, e.g. `vi`; omitted: the default language.
